title: Let the heart be kept in what is complete
summary: Everything becomes whole when the Name is kept in the heart. Lean where you are already being held.
takeaway: Lean where you are already being held.
lifeApplication: When the urge to hold yourself up alone returns, say the line like a child asking to be kept and let one breath soften.

source.shortMeaning: Everything becomes whole when the Name is kept in the heart.
source.lifeApplication: In the feeling of lack, take shelter and return to the Name before grasping again.

evidence.coreClaim: Everything becomes whole when the Name is kept in the heart.
evidence.turn: Let this stay with you: wholeness begins when the Name is kept in the heart.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the urge to hold yourself up alone returns, say the line like a child asking to be kept and let one breath soften.
